proposed_widenings.name: species_trait lineage-choice composite
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is one species trait that requires a permanent build-time choice between mutually exclusive subpackages, and one branch combines passive spell grants with an activated ability. Current SpeciesTraitMechanics only allows passive or activation, not a choose-one composite over both.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose...

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access PB-per-long-rest free casts
proposed_widenings.justification: Forest Gnome grants a prepared spell that can be cast for free a number of times equal to Proficiency Bonus, then also remains castable with spell slots. Current grant_spell_access modes cover prepared and once_per_long_rest, but not PB-scaled free casts.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access spellcasting ability choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait fixes a chosen spellcasting ability for all spells cast through the lineage. Current grant_spell_access can override DC, area, target, and duration, but not the ability source used for spell attacks/save DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage)

proposed_widenings.name: activated created-object spell device
proposed_widenings.justification: Rock Gnome creates a persistent Tiny device that stores one chosen Prestidigitation effect, can later be activated by touch as a Bonus Action, is capped at three concurrent devices, and expires after 8 hours or dismantling. The current surface has no honest non-spell object-creation/stored-effect lifecycle for species traits.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device ... the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch ... You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action.

notes: No content file authored. Forest Gnome nearly fits passive spell-access grants, but the top-level lineage choice and Rock Gnome's passive-plus-activated device package make the unit a structural mismatch first.
